## Supervisor postwrite acceptance observation — capture-result shape and exact evidence references

Fresh explicit-workspace reads of record 01a0ddde-0d24-7978-9af4-6ed850a5cbfc (revision 7), C1 01a0ddac-eb7a-7288-849a-eb75fb015eb0 and parent 01a0dda7-01b9-76f7-b53b-e2e629a042c2, including full comment lists and exposed attachment inventories, retain two observations for the planned independent postwrite gates:

1. Curator event 01a0dde0-af7c-7d80-999d-56e0b6772bdd contains narrative R1/R2/R3, and C1 completion comment 01a0dde0-b2d3-76b3-aa15-715a32ad92c4 summarizes them. No published schema-shaped WorkspaceKnowledgeCaptureResult was observed in these inspected bodies/comments/attachments. The exposed attachments are the existing MissionLearningSource, Supervisor closure summary and contract schema bundle; the contract definition itself is not an executed capture result. This is a bounded observation, not proof that no worker-local or separately referenced artifact exists. First resolve any actual existing CaptureResult artifact before calling it missing or producing another.

The unchanged local schema engcim/swarm/contracts/rc10/WorkspaceKnowledgeCaptureResult.schema.json requires exactly captureRef, knowledgeRef, workspaceRef, projectRef, proposalRef, sourceRefs, evidenceRefs, capturedAt; additionalProperties=false. Scalar values must be nonempty strings; sourceRefs/evidenceRefs must be nonempty arrays of nonempty strings. Planned postwrite Verifier/Reviewer should check the actual instance, provider identity and factual capture time against real command/provider evidence, separately from the identity/decision/readback envelope and narrative replay receipts. A knowledge record body is not automatically this CaptureResult. Do not invent capturedAt or substitute the time of a later report for capture without evidence.

2. The current record's structured governance.evidenceRefs still includes truncated run:01a0ddcd-3d0b. The actual full independent Verifier run is run:01a0ddcd-3d0b-7dc3-ae46-305889037b53. Inspect exact structured-reference resolvability and bind the full provider identity. Retain existing correct full comment references comment:01a0ddc8-5eff-7685-b055-2906b34b3266 and comment:01a0ddd3-97bc-7037-9dbb-94cf79f29e35; this observation does not invalidate all evidence or replace either verdict.

If correction is needed, use the existing Curator/Orchestrator path for only the minimal receipt/reference correction, under the remaining original two-correction allowance, with an additive audit trail and fresh readback of affected bytes/identity. Keep the exact adopted proposal digest 5fba147a9bc32231fa3cea99d04eb7300390485de340bc1521cbd35f89b4176e, recordKey/version binding and existing independent gate verdicts intact; verify the proposal hash remains unchanged and independently check affected receipt/reference bytes. No broader rewrite, gate waiver or replacement verdict. Supervisor has not written any knowledge record or capture receipt; this comment is only an acceptance observation and is not a CaptureResult.

Fold these checks into the planned independent postwrite Verifier and Reviewer gates. Verify author_id/source_task_id rather than headings. Preserve negative/failed evidence and original receipts. This note requests no new worker dispatch by Supervisor, source/configuration changes or new mechanism. Current Mission continuation ends at 2026-09-26T13:45:00Z with no extension; respect concurrency and correction budgets, stop new dispatch at the bound, and report unresolved acceptance honestly. No S02 or Human DONE.
